added.summary: A particles file's `sheet <columns> <rows> <frames> life <cycles> | fps <n> blend` cross-fades each flipbook frame into the next as it plays, so a 16-frame smoke or fire sheet rolls smoothly instead of stepping; a sheet played once holds its last frame rather than fading back to the first. Billboards on the GPU and CPU paths; refused with `off`, `random` or sprite mode. Without `blend`, sheets draw as before.
